☀️ About WrkZone

Local help, made simple.

WrkZone is a friendly classifieds marketplace that connects skilled handymen — plumbers, AC technicians, pest control, cleaners, electricians and more — directly with the people who need them. No middlemen, no commissions, just honest work.

🧑‍🔧

For service providers

Create a free account, post your service ad with photos and pricing, and start receiving calls and WhatsApp messages from local customers. Build your reputation with ratings and reviews.

🏠

For customers

Search by service and city, compare providers, read reviews, and contact pros directly. Everything you need to get the job done — fast.

🛡️

Safe & trusted

Every ad is reviewed by our team before going live. We encourage in-person verification and safe payment practices.

💛

Always free to start

Posting your first ads is completely free. Optional featured listings help you stand out when you're ready to grow.
